description: This file defines API routes and handlers for managing user sessions in a backend application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting sessions, as well as posting messages and handling related data, all integrated with a Supabase backend using FastAPI dependencies.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates a Supabase client using environment variables, selecting either service role or anonymous key.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all sessions for the authenticated user, returning a list of session summaries.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new session for the authenticated user, enforcing RLS policies.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session by ID along with its associated messages.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Updates the title of an existing session owned by the user.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Deletes a session owned by the user.

methods.name: post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Posts a user message to a session after verifying ownership and that at least one file is uploaded, then returns a stub response.
